description: Complete coal mining setup — fix unpowered drills and verify belt connections

steps.description: Extend power to unpowered electric mining drills at (41.5,-59.5) and (44.5,-56.5)
steps.notes: Both drills now powered and connected. Placed poles at (39.5,-58.5) and (42.5,-55.5). Built belt connections: south-facing belt at (39.5,-59.5), underground belts under drill at y=-56.5, extended spine at x=33.5 from y=-60.5 to y=-58.5

steps.description: Verify belt connections from all drills lead to the coal delivery line
steps.notes: All 5 electric drills verified: powered, mining coal, connected to belt network. All showing waiting_for_space_in_destination — belts are saturated.

steps.description: Check overall coal flow is working
steps.notes: Coal flow verified end-to-end: drills → express belts west → spine south at x=33.5 → splitters at y=-45.5 and y=-40.5 → boilers + loader. System is fully saturated — all belts full of coal.

notes: Coal mining setup complete. Fixed 2 unpowered electric drills by placing poles at (39.5,-58.5) and (42.5,-55.5). Connected drill outputs to belt network: south-facing belt at (39.5,-59.5) for one drill, west-going belt row with underground belts at y=-56.5 for the other. Extended spine at x=33.5 from y=-60.5 to y=-58.5 to merge all coal onto the main delivery line. All 5 electric drills operational and belts fully saturated.

description: Build transport belt production line: iron-gear-wheel assembler + basic-transport-belt assembler → transport-belt assembler

steps.notes: Placed 2 assembling-machine-2 with recipes set (basic-transport-belt and transport-belt). Skipped crafting 3rd - only 2 available.

steps.description: Walk to build area and place assemblers
steps.notes: Placed AM2 #1 at (-43,9) with basic-transport-belt recipe, AM2 #2 at (-37,9) with transport-belt recipe

steps.description: Connect inserters and belts between machines
steps.notes: Placed inserters, belt, output chest, electric poles. All machines powered.

steps.description: Add input chest for iron plates
steps.notes: Loaded 60 iron plates into iron plate chest, 20 gears into AM1 gear chest, 16 gears into AM2 gear chest

steps.description: Add output chest for transport belts
steps.notes: Output chest has 16 transport-belts. Production line fully functional!

notes: Transport belt production line built and verified. 2 assembling-machine-2 with inserters, input chests, and output chest. Produced 16 transport belts from iron plates + iron gears. Full chain: iron-plate + iron-gear → basic-transport-belt → transport-belt.
